name: DIPHENIDOL HYDROCHLORIDE 40MG/2ML INJECTABLE SOLUTION 1 PIECE
description: Diphenidol 25 mg is an antiemetic and antivertigo medication used to prevent and treat nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and vertigo. It is always essential to consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking this medication. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
